title: synstylis micranthera
intro:
Synstylis micranthera, commonly known as the "red fringe lily" or "red fringe water lily," is a type of aquatic plant native to Australia, classified in the family Haemodoraceae.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Synstylis micranthera include its ability to soothe and calm the body, particularly in the treatment of skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
